title: Long Path
statementMd:
One day, little Vasya found himself in a maze consisting of $(*n* + 1)$ rooms, numbered from $1$ to $(*n* + 1)$. Initially, Vasya is at the first room and to get out of the maze, he needs to get to the $(*n* + 1)$-th one.

The maze is organized as follows. Each room of the maze has two one-way portals. Let's consider room number $*i*$ $(1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*)$, someone can use the first portal to move from it to room number $(*i* + 1)$, also someone can use the second portal to move from it to room number $*p*_{*i*}$, where $1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ *i*$.

In order not to get lost, Vasya decided to act as follows.

- Each time Vasya enters some room, he paints a cross on its ceiling. Initially, Vasya paints a cross at the ceiling of room $1$.
- Let's assume that Vasya is in room $*i*$ and has already painted a cross on its ceiling. Then, if the ceiling now contains an odd number of crosses, Vasya uses the second portal (it leads to room $*p*_{*i*}$), otherwise Vasya uses the first portal.

Help Vasya determine the number of times he needs to use portals to get to room $(*n* + 1)$ in the end.

## Input

The first line contains integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{3}$) — the number of rooms. The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*p*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ *i*$). Each $*p*_{*i*}$ denotes the number of the room, that someone can reach, if he will use the second portal in the $*i*$-th room.

## Output

Print a single number — the number of portal moves the boy needs to go out of the maze. As the number can be rather large, print it modulo $1000000007$ $(10^{9} + 7)$.
statementZhMd:
一天，小瓦夏发现自己身处一个由 $(*n* + 1)$ 个房间组成的迷宫中，这些房间编号为 $1$ 到 $(*n* + 1)$。最初，瓦夏位于第一个房间。为了走出迷宫，他需要到达第 $(*n* + 1)$ 个房间。

迷宫的结构如下。迷宫中的每个房间都有两个单向传送门。考虑编号为 $*i*$ 的房间 $(1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*)$：使用第一个传送门可以从该房间移动到编号为 $(*i* + 1)$ 的房间，使用第二个传送门可以移动到编号为 $*p*_{*i*}$ 的房间，其中 $1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ *i*$。

为了不迷路，瓦夏决定按照以下方式行动：

- 每当瓦夏进入某个房间时，他都会在该房间的天花板上画一个十字。初始时，瓦夏会在房间 $1$ 的天花板上画一个十字。
- 假设瓦夏位于房间 $*i*$，并且已经在其天花板上画了一个十字。那么，如果此时天花板上的十字数量为奇数，瓦夏就使用第二个传送门（它通往房间 $*p*_{*i*}$）；否则，他使用第一个传送门。

请帮助瓦夏确定他最终到达房间 $(*n* + 1)$ 需要使用多少次传送门。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{3}$），表示房间的数量。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*p*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ *i*$）。$*p*_{*i*}$ 表示在第 $*i*$ 个房间使用第二个传送门时可以到达的房间编号。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，表示男孩走出迷宫所需要进行的传送门移动次数。由于答案可能很大，请输出其对 $1000000007$（$10^{9} + 7$）取模后的结果。
